newsitem.title: GREECE: Long-term ecu/drachma vols flat on rangebound spot.
newsitem.headline: Long-term ecu/drachma vols flat on rangebound spot.

text.p: Implied volatilities for long-term ecu/drachma options were steady with the spot ecu/drachma cross locked in the 309.85-310.20 corridor underpinned by higher interbank drachma rates, dealers said.
"There is little change in implied volatilities for long-dated ecu/drachma on a calm spot," said a senior options dealer at private Alpha Credit Bank.
Ecu/drachma has been ranging between 309.85-310.20 in the last few days after going through a volatile period that saw it higher at 312.40 in late May.
"Large spreads of 2.0 percent help absorb short-lived shocks or sharp moves in spot ecu/drachma and minimise the need for re-adjusting implied volatilities continuously," he said.
The typical dealing size is 10 to 20 million ecus in terms of notionals in the local market with most trading activity concentrated in ecu/drachma and mark/drachma calls and puts.

"There is more activity in ecu/drachma puts with deltas ranging from 0.6 to 0.7 and mark/drachma options with deltas between 0.3 and 0.4," the options trader said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
